packageRules.description: Keep the shared runtime image reference aligned with updated tool and base-image inputs, and copy the npm pins into the one/ overlay with its own sync script.

one/tools/package.json is a copy of env/tools/package.json (one/tools/sync-shared.sh, checked by build-t3-runtime), written by the postUpgradeTasks above. Renovate must not update it as its own package file: the env/-only rules never matched the one/ upgrade, so t3 resolved to preview there instead of nightly, and because that upgrade became upgrades[0], whose settings Renovate uses for the whole branch, postUpgradeTasks was silently skipped (statefulset drift on PRs #1488, #1497, #1498, #1502) and platformAutomerge false was dropped.
Shared T3 pod/LXC CLI pins. Native npm updates the package and lock together; ArgoCD rolls merged updates. Patch automerge follows the repo policy.
Authentik: chart version and container image move together upstream. Group them in one PR so ArgoCD never sees a chart/image schema mismatch.

Auto-merge patches across the repo. Renovate now owns all docker digest + patch bumps for the servarr stack end-to-end (Image Updater retired — #192); this rule covers patch bumps repo-wide (incl. chart-only patches), with the dedicated servarr-digest rule below handling digest re-rolls.

Servarr digest rebuilds auto-merge. Release tags make minor/major changes typed updates (#1129). Moving-tag exceptions and registry evidence are in docs/servarr-image-pins.md; later rules require review for development images.
Servarr minor and major releases require review for migrations and breaking changes (#1129). Patch updates and same-tag digest rebuilds retain their earlier automerge rules.
Hotio release tags have a release- prefix. Parse the numeric version so patch/minor/major updates remain discoverable (#1129).
qBittorrent's numeric suffix is an image rebuild, not a compatibility constraint. Track rebuilds as patches while keeping the separate lt2 variant excluded (#1129).

Streamystats' pinned build has no matching release tag (#1129). These moving tags can carry unreleased migrations, so every update needs review. Keep this after the digest and patch automerge rules. Lingarr left this rule with the batch-contract override: the kustomization entry now carries newName ghcr.io/spyrospsarras/lingarr (disabled by the overlay rule below), so the upstream name no longer extracts as a dependency - the build-lingarr.yml invariant guard covers the upstream base digest instead.

CLIProxyAPI: never auto-merge, any update type (#1221). Tracking resumed when the pr-5411 fork was retired and the pin went back to this tag stream, so the repo-wide patch automerge at the top of this list would otherwise own it. Two reasons it must not: this image is the gateway every agent session talks to, so a bad bump stops all coding work at once, and upstream ships fast - 27 releases in the 20 days from v7.2.148 (2026-09-03) to v7.3.15 (2026-09-23), including the v7.3.0 minor. The binary also impersonates a pinned Claude Code version (claude_device_profile.go, 2.1.280 at v7.3.15), so a release can change which Anthropic models are accepted, in both directions. PR opens, you merge it when you are not mid-task.
Authentik MINOR/MAJOR: never auto-merge — release notes can carry DB migrations and breaking changes. PR opens, you review, you click merge.

Lingarr build SDK: majors must never be bumped by Renovate (#1372). The dotnet/sdk tag in images/lingarr/Dockerfile has to satisfy upstream Lingarr's own global.json, cloned in-container at UPSTREAM_COMMIT (currently 10.0.0, rollForward latestMinor) - an SDK 11 image fails dotnet restore with exit 155, as PR #1372's build run showed. Our repo holds no global.json, so the dotnet-sdk manager cannot own this either. Minors stay enabled and valid: rollForward latestMinor accepts any 10.x. Lift this rule only in the same change that moves UPSTREAM_COMMIT to a .NET 11 source, and pick the matching SDK tag by reading upstream's global.json at the new commit.

Self-hosted Renovate image: every update adopted by hand via the images: override in 2-k3s/12.renovate/kustomization.yaml (was: minor+patch suppressed, majors opened a PR). The v44 major got as far as its branch but the PR never opened; every in-window run re-attempted PR creation and hung until activeDeadlineSeconds killed it, 16 consecutive failures across 4 nights from 2026-07-29, while out-of-window runs stayed fast because the schedule skips this update entirely (#595, mechanism inferred from the last log line, not confirmed: release-notes fetch against renovatebot/renovate's multi-thousand-release history). Branch renovate/ghcr.io-renovatebot-renovate-44.x deleted at ddfe5d9, recoverable from that sha. To adopt: bump newTag by hand, confirm the next in-window run completes, and in the same PR either keep this rule or restore major-opens-a-PR.

Temporary PR-build image (#1336): ghcr.io/spyrospsarras/jellysweep:pr-430 is a one-off build of jon4hz/jellysweep#430 (Database Filter matches tracked rows by media type, not arr ID alone), pinned with an immutable digest while upstream review is pending. A PR build has no tag stream, so tracking it is permanent lookup-failure noise. The images: block in 2-k3s/08.servarr/kustomization.yaml carries a TEMP OVERRIDE comment naming the revert condition: when a jellysweep release > v0.16.0 ships containing #430, the pin goes back to ghcr.io/jon4hz/jellysweep and this rule is deleted in the same PR.

Temporary overlay image (batch-contract): ghcr.io/spyrospsarras/lingarr is a build of lingarr-translate/lingarr main 28f6a19 + images/lingarr/batch-contract.patch (chat batch path publishes untranslated lines, its schema-less fallback NREs on null model content, the content API cancels translations when the caller disconnects - Bazarr's 1920s timeout made big files untranslatable - and the batch path treats provider 429/503 as fatal instead of retrying), pinned with an immutable digest until upstream ships the equivalents. The images: block in 2-k3s/08.servarr/kustomization.yaml carries a TEMP OVERRIDE comment naming the revert condition, watched by upstream-release-watch row #270. The digest has no tag stream Renovate could follow, so tracking it is permanent lookup-failure noise. Upstream churn reaches the overlay through images/lingarr/Dockerfile, whose UPSTREAM_COMMIT/base-digest pair is watch-managed: upstream-release-watch row #270 carries the procedure, and build-lingarr.yml's invariant guard fails the build when the base digest's source revision is not UPSTREAM_COMMIT - the :main tag has regressed twice (PR #1368, then #1434 on 2026-09-17). The upstream base digest itself is untracked: see the disable rule below.

Upstream lingarr base digest in images/lingarr/Dockerfile: tracking disabled. Renovate followed the moving ghcr :main tag into BASE_IMAGE, but upstream flip-flops that tag - it regressed to the older 5eadc933 (release 1.3.0) build twice (merged as PR #1368 on 2026-09-13, then re-raised as #1434 on 2026-09-17), and build-lingarr.yml's invariant guard correctly rejected the second one: BASE_IMAGE's org.opencontainers.image.revision label must equal UPSTREAM_COMMIT, because the base carries the wwwroot build for that same commit (see the Dockerfile header). Renovate can only ever propose the updates that must NOT be taken: a digest bump without moving UPSTREAM_COMMIT first is always a guard failure, and when UPSTREAM_COMMIT does move, the same human PR picks the digest whose revision label equals the new commit. The update signal instead comes from upstream-release-watch row #270 (weekly, on releases past baseline 1.3.0): ALL five batch-contract behaviors shipped -> revert the overlay per its checklist; SOME -> move UPSTREAM_COMMIT plus the matching digest in one PR. Scoped to images/lingarr/Dockerfile so the rule dies with the overlay directory, like the #1372 SDK rule above.

CLIProxyAPI plugin pins (#997): NEVER auto-merge, and this rule MUST stay after the repo-wide patch rule above, because later packageRules win. Renovate cannot compute the sha256 of a release zip, so it bumps the version and leaves the checksum stale. The fetch script fails CLOSED on a mismatch with exit 1, which fails the initContainer, which means an auto-merged patch bump would take cliproxy.epaflix.com down at the next sync rather than merely skipping a plugin. A plugin 0.9.1 -> 0.9.2 IS a patch, so the generic automerge rule would have caught these. The ci.yml step 'CLIProxyAPI plugin pins match upstream checksums' turns that stale checksum into a red gate instead of an outage, but this rule is the first line: a human updates the checksum from the release's own checksums.txt and pushes it to the Renovate branch before merging.

Pin the CI validate-gate helm to 3.x. The reason is NOT that helm v4 is unproven in general — it is GA (v4.2.3). It is that this gate's only job is to predict whether ArgoCD's repo-server can render this repo, and that repo-server bundles helm 3.19.4 (argo-cd chart 9.7.0 / ArgoCD v3.4.4, observed 2026-08-03). A gate rendering with a newer helm MAJOR than the thing that actually deploys is a false green: it passes on templating/OCI semantics ArgoCD then rejects. #384/#386 are exactly that failure, already survived once, with a chart major instead of a helm major. So the unblock condition is mechanical, not a soak: when the ArgoCD repo-server image ships helm 4.x, raise this cap to <5 in the same PR as the argo-cd chart bump. Check with `helm version --short` inside the running repo-server pod. Within-major drift the other way is fine and expected (gate 3.21.0 vs repo-server 3.19.4) — only the major has to match. #221/#164/#331.

Pin the CI validate-gate kustomize to 5.x by the same rule as helm above: the repo-server bundles kustomize 5.3.0 (+ksops v4.3.3, observed 2026-08-03), so the gate must stay on kustomize 5.x. This cap suppresses nothing today — upstream has no v6, latest is kustomize/v5.8.1. Raise to <7 when the repo-server ships kustomize 6.x. #221/#164/#331.

t3 follows the npm nightly dist-tag. The desktop app on the laptop runs nightly and shows every server on an older version as behind. Automerge is set here too because the patch rule below only covers 0.0.x bumps. A 0.1.0-nightly bump is a minor and would otherwise fall back to automerge false.
T3 patches: Renovate waits for CI itself because this repository has no required status checks for GitHub platform automerge.

customManagers.description: Keep every pinned HELM_VERSION fresh: ci.yml (the secret-free validate gate's Install tools step), upstream-release-watch.yml (the renderer used by shape-probe rows, #290) and 2-k3s/13.t3code/versions.env (the t3code guest's cluster tooling, kept at the gate's version). Marker is an inline trailing comment '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the HELM_VERSION= line. Split out from a single shared regex manager (was kustomize+helm) because one regex manager carries only one extractVersionTemplate, and kustomize needs one while helm does not — helm/helm github-releases auto-strips the leading v, so no extractVersion here. #222/#220. Uses managerFilePatterns, the correct native field on the deployed Renovate — the bot runs 43.33.2, set via the images: override in 2-k3s/12.renovate/kustomization.yaml, not the stale 39.264.0 literal in cronjob.yaml (that literal is dead, see #486). This manager extracts helm/helm fine on every run; the branch just never becomes a PR, because it touches .github/workflows/ and the PAT lacks the workflow scope to push that diff — root cause tracked in #486.

Keep the pinned KUSTOMIZE_VERSION in ci.yml (the secret-free validate gate's Install tools step) and 2-k3s/13.t3code/versions.env (the t3code guest) fresh. Marker is an inline trailing comment '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' on the KUSTOMIZE_VERSION= line. Split out from the shared helm+kustomize regex manager (#222/#220): kustomize github-releases tags are 'kustomize/vX.Y.Z', so extractVersion strips that prefix — without it the bump would be silently no-op or wrong. One regex manager carries only one extractVersionTemplate, hence the split from helm. Uses managerFilePatterns, the correct native field on the deployed Renovate — same as the HELM_VERSION manager above, the bot runs 43.33.2 per the kustomization.yaml images: override, and the branch this manager computes gets its push rejected for missing workflow PAT scope, not a config problem — see #486.
Guest argo-cd and sops pins. Shared npm CLI pins moved to env/tools/package.json under the native npm manager. The guest timer applies merged pins every 2 minutes (provision.sh).

Keep the two CLIProxyAPI plugin versions in 2-k3s/17.remote-pi/cliproxy/deployment.yaml fresh (#997). Both plugins are fetched by cliproxy/files/fetch-plugin.sh from initContainer args, which Renovate's kustomize/docker managers cannot see: a plugin is a GitHub release zip, not an image. Marker is a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment on the line ABOVE the quoted version arg, the same shape as the HELM_VERSION managers above but leading rather than trailing, because a YAML sequence item carrying a trailing comment reads badly next to a sha256 on the next line. The version appears exactly ONCE per plugin on purpose: fetch-plugin.sh composes the release URL from <owner/repo>, the version and the plugin id, because a regex manager rewrites one captured span and a version repeated in a tag, a filename and an arg would come out inconsistent. Renovate CANNOT update the sha256 on the following line - see the matching packageRule, which blocks auto-merge, and the ci.yml step that fails the gate when the pinned checksum does not match the release's own checksums.txt.

Keep the pinned AIRVPN_SUITE_VERSION in images/airvpn-bluetit/Dockerfile fresh. Renovate only ever sees the image tag we publish ourselves (ghcr.io/spyrospsarras/airvpn-bluetit), so without this regex manager nothing would ever report the vendored 2.1.0 tarball as stale. The bump also needs AIRVPN_SUITE_SHA512 updated by hand from AirVPN's published checksum - Renovate cannot compute that, see images/airvpn-bluetit/README.md. Uses managerFilePatterns, the correct native field on the deployed Renovate. The bot runs 43.33.2, set via the images: override in 2-k3s/12.renovate/kustomization.yaml, not the stale 39.264.0 literal in cronjob.yaml below — that literal was never what actually ran, and this manager (like the other two above) extracted fine the whole time (#486). This file isn't under .github/workflows/, so it doesn't hit the workflow-scope push rejection that blocks the ci.yml managers. Datasource is the custom.airvpn-suite-x86_64 entry below, not gitlab-tags: AirVPN/AirVPN-Suite has no upstream git tags or GitLab releases at all (verified via the GitLab API) - versions only ever show up as tarball filenames under binary/ on master, see #487.

airvpn-suite-x86_64.description: AirVPN/AirVPN-Suite publishes no git tags or GitLab releases (#487, re-verified live: both endpoints return an empty list) - the only signal of a new version is a new tarball filename under binary/ on master. Lists that directory via the GitLab repository-tree API and extracts versions from the x86_64, non-legacy tarball name (AirVPN-Suite-x86_64-<version>.tar.gz). The directory also holds -legacy and aarch64/armv7l/hummingbird-macos-* variants and .sha512 sidecar files for each - the regex anchors on the exact x86_64 non-legacy filename shape so none of those can produce a bogus version. per_page=100 is GitLab's hard cap and the tree endpoint has no order_by/sort/filter parameter (checked against the GitLab API docs), so neither raising per_page nor sorting server-side is possible. #495 worried this directory grows ~8 entries per release and will eventually overflow page 1 - live diffing the 2.0.0 and 2.1.0 trees shows that premise is wrong: each release replaces the prior version's files in place (both trees hold exactly 20 entries), and the count only grows when AirVPN adds a wholly new platform variant, which has happened twice in the project's history (2023: +8 for hummingbird-macos, later: +2 for armv7l). Real headroom today is 20/100. transformTemplates below still fails loud via $error() if the response ever reaches the per_page cap, so a future truncation risk shows up as a 'Package lookup failures' WARN (same channel already covering the newtarr and odysseus lookup failures) instead of silently reporting no update - see #495.
transformTemplates: $count($) >= 100 ? $error("AIRVPN_SUITE_VERSION: GitLab tree API returned " & $string($count($)) & " entries (>= per_page cap 100) - possible pagination truncation, check binary/ listing manually, see #495") : {"releases": [$[$match(name, /^AirVPN-Suite-x86_64-\d[\w.]*\.tar\.gz$/)].{"version": $match(name, /^AirVPN-Suite-x86_64-(\d[\w.]*)\.tar\.gz$/).groups[0]}]}
